_about: Hand-picked directory of cloud, cybersecurity and automation companies. Every entry links to the official website and careers page. kind = "startup" (young, venture-backed) or "established". Optional jobBoard = the company's public Ashby/Greenhouse/Lever board, used to show live open roles. To add a company, copy an entry and keep the same fields.
